objective: The web-dependency-security check fails closed since 2026-10-06 (first seen on the integration run after PR #431, run 37485375037, job 112343905833): `npm audit --audit-level=low` reports advisory GHSA-wq5f-xc86-pv6w, severity high, 'sharp : Vulnerability in librsvg dependency CVE-2026-96889', affecting sharp < 0.35.5, first patched in 0.35.5 (the advisory was published by the package's maintainer on 2026-09-30T19:22:51Z (api.github.com/repos/lovell/sharp/security-advisories/GHSA-wq5f-xc86-pv6w) and entered in GitHub's advisory database on 2026-10-06T13:43:57Z, the day the check began to report it). apps/web/package-lock.json locks sharp 0.35.4, an optional dependency of next 15.5.24 (range ^0.34.3 || ^0.35.3), held there by the exact override "sharp": "0.35.4" in apps/web/package.json. Repair it under the NORMAL dependency policy, with no exception of any kind: move the override to exactly 0.35.5 and regenerate the lock through .github/workflows/generate-lockfile.yml (never by hand, never on a local machine). Registry facts read by the orchestrator on 2026-10-06 at 15:21 UTC from registry.npmjs.org: sharp 0.35.5 published 2026-09-27T13:46:24.509Z; its 16 @img/sharp-* platform packages at 0.35.5 (15 named by sharp 0.35.5 and @img/sharp-wasm32, a dependency of two of them) published 2026-09-27 between 13:45:21Z and 13:47:45Z; its 10 @img/sharp-libvips-* packages at 1.3.4 published 2026-09-27 between 12:10:37Z and 12:11:24Z; every one more than 604800 seconds old at that reading (the youngest 783261 s). Its other dependencies (semver ^7.8.5, @img/colour ^1.1.0, detect-libc ^2.1.2) are unchanged from 0.35.4. No package name is new to the lock. The machine gates decide: the workflow's npm audit must report zero findings at every severity and its committed-lock age gate must pass on every package; if either fails, STOP and report - no waiver, no exclusion, no change to .npmrc or to the gate.
business_reason: CLAUDE.md principle 15 and the dependency-security directive D-009: no dependency may carry an unresolved advisory affecting the installed version, and audits fail closed (D-009-R002); the web lock is regenerated through the CI workflow and validated there (D-009-R017). Blocker B-030: while the advisory stands, every pull request and every integration run fails the web-dependency-security check, and the fail-closed merge step refuses every merge. Three reviewed pull requests (#443, #447, #448) and the review register (M4-T023) wait behind it. Ordinary work under the standing policy (ADR-006 Tier A; the dependency change itself is security-reviewed, gate G5); the fixed version already meets the 7-day rule, so no owner exception is needed or sought.
